ImageDescription.value: This picture captures the ethereal beauty of the Kedarnath Temple in the first rays of the morning sun. Located in Uttarakhand, the Kedarnath Temple is one of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites. As the sun begins to rise, its golden rays illuminate the towering Himalayan peaks, creating a stunning contrast with the cool, blue shadows that still linger in the valley.
